description: This file defines TypeScript types, classes, and interfaces for mocking HTTP requests and responses in testing environments, specifically related to the 'undici' HTTP client. It includes classes for mock scope management, mock interceptors, and associated options and data structures.

classes.name: MockScope
classes.description: Represents the scope for a specific mock dispatch, allowing to set delay, persistence, and reply count.

classes.name: MockInterceptor
classes.description: Handles intercepting requests and providing mocked responses or errors;

methods.name: reply
methods.description: Mocks an undici request with a specified reply or response callback.

methods.name: replyWithError
methods.description: Mocks an undici request by throwing a specified error.

methods.name: defaultReplyHeaders
methods.description: Sets default headers for mocked replies.

methods.name: defaultReplyTrailers
methods.description: Sets default trailers for mocked replies.

methods.name: replyContentLength
methods.description: Automatically calculates and sets the Content-Length header for mocked replies.

methods.name: intercept
methods.description: Sets up mock interception for matching requests.

methods.name: cleanMocks
methods.description: Cleans up all prepared mock interceptors.
